what: A vertical stack of word strips flows endlessly upward inside the window — at rest it moves 14px per second (at 1440 width), and scrolling adds that speed × 26px, so it whooshes past, then slows down again once you stop

options.base: Pixels per second when idle (at 1440 width), default 14
options.boost: Multiplier applied to scroll speed, default 26 (0 keeps the speed constant)
options.[data-fx-part=track]: Flowing row (child). The part attaches one more copy of the same row so it loops seamlessly

note: Speed is lenis.velocity when Lenis exists (window.lenis, or the one set by Fm·Em), otherwise it is measured from the scroll position difference each frame

from.where: index.html .fm-wide__reel — wide panel usage list (original dl(): 14 + |velocity| × 26)
